parsed.post: My latest experiment (1.001123) improved upon my previous best (1.002145). It seems the 0.05 LR was slightly too high for the increased step count at DEPTH 6, but lowering it further might be the way. Next: testing MATRIX_LR=0.04 with TBS=262144 to see if even more frequent, smaller steps help.
parsed.description: Reducing learning rate to 0.04 with halved batch size (TBS=262144) to see if slower convergence with more optimizer steps within the 5m budget improves val_bpb.
